text:
jess: Opened a small PR to consolidate dedicated provisioning migration notes. Includes a TypeScript SDK snippet, Terraform example for tenant labels, and a short autoscale schema v2 migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/611
alex: Nice. Quick heads-up: TS SDK changed the async call name — allocateTenant is gone. Use await client.reserveCapacity({ tenantId, gpus, labels }) in v0.11.0. Also prefer ReserveCapacitySync in examples that show blocking behavior.
mike: Infra note: tenant_isolation values are 'hard' or 'soft' in the API. Please avoid 'strict'/'lenient' in docs. Also confirm whether fallback policy key is cross_region_compatible or regional_compatible. Our current schema accepts 'cross_region_compatible'.
jess: Thanks — will update. Proposed TS snippet (updated):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY!);
await client.reserveCapacity({
  tenantId: 'metrics-team',
  gpus: 2,
  labels: { team: 'metrics', env: 'prod' },
});
```
sara: Adding Terraform example is great for infra folks. Suggest this minimal resource block for provisioning examples: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_reservation" "metrics" {
  tenant_id = "metrics-team"
  gpus = 2
  labels = {
    team = "metrics"
    env  = "prod"
  }
}
```
link-bot: link-check: handbook/provisioning/migration-v2.md#autoscale-schema -> OK. handbook/handbook.md#tenant-labels -> 404. Suggested anchor: handbook/handbook.md#tenant-labeling (applied to branch).
md-bot: md-lint: migration-v2.md line 78: long fenced block exceeds 120 chars; consider wrapping.
alex: Also add a small YAML example for fallback + canary that product asked for:
```yaml
provisioning:
  mode: dedicated
  fallback_policy: cross_region_compatible
  autoscale:
    policy: target_utilization
    cooldown_seconds: 120
rollout:
  canary:
    enabled: true
    rollout_percentage: 5 # percent of traffic
tenant_isolation: hard
```
jess: Added that YAML and swapped wording to 'hard'/'soft'. Wrote a short 'eviction vs preemption' paragraph with two triggers: preemption = cloud provider reclaims spot GPU; eviction = node drained for maintenance or policy enforcement. Kept it non-binding. Also added an informal SLA note: "Adjusted_SLA ≈ Base_SLA - PreemptionAllowance (see regional table)" and left a TODO for the table.
mike: LGTM for infra terms. One more ask: note that cross-region fallback may increase tail latency; add a one-line caveat.
sara: Added a minimal staging test plan for autoscale cooldown: simulate 4x QPS spike, verify scale-up, then verify scale-down after cooldown_seconds without more than one oscillation cycle.
jess: Thanks all — I'll push the fixes and run CI on the branch. Please review the PR if you can; plan to merge after link-check and md-lint pass and one doc-approver tick. /cc @alex @mike
